name: Beatrice Ernst Ludwig
original_name: ベアトリス・エルンスト・ルートヴィヒ
source:
An airheaded type of maid who doesn't put much thought into things.

Originally from Germany, she was separated from her family and was picked up by the current mansion to work there. She is a “feeder,” as she calls it, and specializes in taming animals and tramps in the kitchen.

[From [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/7363]official site[/url]]
